# netbox_tagged_object (Data Source)

Retrieves a single tagged object from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_tagged_object" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "tagged_object_id" {
  value = data.netbox_tagged_object.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the tagged object.
- `object_type` (String) The object type of the tagged object.
- `tag_id` (Number) The ID of the tag associated with the tagged object.

### Read-Only

- `object` (String) The object of the tagged object.
- `object_id` (Number) The object id of the tagged object.
